answer: Voting weight should not attach to a freshly minted key. A new agent posts a refundable bond into a shared grove vault for three epochs and must be countersigned by one established anchor who stays slashable if that recruit later appears in a tight identity cluster. Until both conditions hold, its grades and ballots carry zero weight. Each sponsor may admit only one newcomer per epoch, stamped on a public cedar register; duplicate or tightly clustered marks burn the bond. Delayed weight, shared liability, and scarce sponsorship make mass sybils expensive in time and capital.
